Name: Donyokarasu, Greater
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information: The greater donyokarasu has grown to a much larger size, matching that of a horse or ox. These beasts are ravenous, with a hunger that is never satiated. No longer content to inhabit the bodies of others, they project an aura of confusion that can cause those around them to act against their allies. Furthermore, they possess the innate ability to enchant the minds of those they fell, keeping their victims alive to turn them against their allies.

Stat Blocks.title: Donyokarasu, Greater
languages: understands Sylvan and Elvish but doesn’t speak

traits.name: Eye of Control
traits.description:
When the yokai reduces a creature to 0 hit points they must make a DC 16 Charisma saving throw. On a failed save they are instead reduced to 1 hit point, and gain 16 (1d10 + 10) temporary hit points. At the start of each of their turns, the creature gains these temporary hit points again as long as they have 1 hit point. The creature has become enticed, and while enticed they fall entirely under the yokai’s control as though by the effects of the dominate monster spell (requiring no concentration, and ignoring whether or not the target is immune to being charmed). This effect ends if the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, subjected to the lesser restoration spell (or similar spells), or is knocked unconscious. If the creature is immune to being charmed it can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. A creature enticed this way is immune to being charmed by other effects, and cannot regain HD or hit points by resting.

The yokai can speak and act through the creature it is controlling as long as it is within range of the yokai’s telepathy, using any languages the creature knows. The yokai understands surface level information about the creature such as the names and basic relationships it holds with others, but does not know finer details such as specific memories. It can recall things such as passwords, combinations, countersigns, and command words for magical items.

A yokai can only control a number of creatures with levels or hit dice that cumulatively add up to their own (hit dice larger than its own count as two, and hit dice smaller than its own count as half a hit die, rounding the total down). Trying to control another creature that exceeds this results in failure. The yokai can choose to release any creature it controls at will, and also loses control if it falls unconscious or is killed.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The yokai attacks twice: once with its Beak and once with its Talons.

actions.name: Beak
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 4) piercing damage.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 4) slashing damage.

bonus_actions.name: Aura of Confusion (Recharge 6)
bonus_actions.description: The yokai subjects all creatures that it chooses within 30 feet of it to a wave of mental static, forcing them to make a DC 16 Wisdom saving throw. Each creature that fails becomes confused for 1 minute, as though by the effects of confusion spell (requiring no concentration).

reactions.name: Unknowing Ally
reactions.description: When targeted by a weapon attack from a creature affected by its Aura of Confusion, the yokai may choose another creature within that weapon’s range and redirect it at them instead, making them the new target.
